deadline.value: UWA accepts most research degree applications throughout the year; only some specific degrees have deadlines.
deadline.quote: You can apply for most postgraduate research degrees (HDR) throughout the year, however, there are deadlines for some specific degrees.

gre_subject.value: The UWA pages fetched for this field do not mention a GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: A supervisor must be confirmed before an application is submitted through the HDR portal.
supervisor.quote: Once you’ve confirmed your supervisor and compiled all required information, you can submit an application through our HDR application portal.

also.quote: Identifying and securing academic supervision is an essential component for admission.

funding.value: UWA awards research scholarships through a competitive, merit-based selection process; no general funding guarantee is stated.
funding.quote: At UWA we award research scholarships through a competitive merit-based selection process

entry_route.value: UWA requires adequate research preparation; the pages fetched do not say whether a bachelor's degree alone is enough.

notes: Honours supervisor rules on the department page apply to honours, not PhD. Statistics is covered by the same department.
